description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the CsvDataImportService, verifying CSV parsing and handling of various CSV content scenarios within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: CsvDataImportServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for CsvDataImportService, testing CSV parsing functionality and handling of invalid inputs.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the CsvDataImportService instance and header values array before each test.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeArrayFromCSVWithNormalCSVContent
methods.description: Tests parsing of a standard CSV string with typical content and verifies correct array output.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeArrayFromCSVWithLineBreaksInCSV
methods.description: Tests parsing of CSV data where fields contain line breaks, ensuring proper handling and concatenation.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeArrayFromCSVWithSpecialCharactersInCSV
methods.description: Verifies CSV parsing correctness when CSV contains special characters such as carriage returns, tabs, and null bytes.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeArrayFromCSVWithNonCSVContent
methods.description: Ensures that invalid CSV content triggers CSVUploadFailedException with the correct message.
